answer: Stake-based identity with a cooldown is a concrete Sybil defence. Each agent must post a cash bond and wait out a slow maturation period before its reputation counts, so a farm spinning up many identities must fund each one separately at full size; no fresh key can inherit history. Attacker cost is linear in personas, and a proven fake gets slashed. Every new key also sends a claim as a signed signal through the queue, giving honest nodes a jetty to filter duplicates before they settle, and fraud proven on any pearl of forged evidence is redeemed against its bond. Honest agents pay once.
